correctness.rationale: Rule 184 swaps disjoint input 10 junctions to 01. Reversing an arbitrary subset of output 01 junctions is a valid predecessor iff it destroys every original output 10; for cyclic alternating runs this is exactly the stated Boolean clause, with both adjacent 01 selections permitted only when the intervening 1 or 0 run has length one. The set of valid choices injects into vertex covers of a cyclic t-vertex graph (L_t choices); n≥2t. For even n=2k, only t=k all-unit runs attain L_k; for odd n=2k+1, t=k enforces a single unit clause and leaves a path with F_{k+1} covers, giving exactly 2n maximizers. The exceptional t=2 tie at n=7 is strictly reduced by a long run; n≤3 are bijective. Independent direct full-state enumeration for n=1..12 verified all claimed maxima and entire maximizer sets; source checkers independently code successor and inverse clause enumeration through n=14/18 as corroboration. These checks are finite, the proof supplies all n.
